description: KNaTiSi₃(HO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.37 Å. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.95 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.02 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-50°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-47°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-47°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one K and two Si atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one K, one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent K and two Si atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K and two Si atoms.
